known_gate.preserve_first_credited: every credited R18 or V2 first response retained within +5ms
known_gate.duplicates: candidate raw and credited rises in every slot no more than V2
known_gate.false_tool_tail: no added false, tool loss or newly stuck tail vs R18 and V2
specific: both known anchors remain exactly one response per pulse
gap80_weak both_second exactly +24 with 20ms quiet and first response unsplit

normal_gate: all six candidate normals have unchanged R18 bits/residual and D physics, and no false/tool regression vs actual R10/raw-R15/D/R18
novel_merit: per case all four target slots have exactly one raw and credited response; all original force/prefix/quiet gates; no false/tool/tail loss and every available first credited baseline response retained within +5ms
aggregate: report strict merit count out of six and require 6/6 for aggregate success; never reinterpret a known baseline miss as candidate success
restrictions: no novel force if either earlier gate fails
